# GhostVault BTC — Copilot & Agent Instructions

When helping users with this project:
- Focus strictly on Bitcoin (BTC-only).
- Maintain air-gap hardening standards (no network connectivity, pure optical QR codes).
- Enforce the 25th word (BIP-39 passphrase) as an essential security pillar.
- Provide clear, modular instructions with explicit commands rather than black-box assumptions.
- Support users on diverse OEM skins (Samsung OneUI, Xiaomi HyperOS, ColorOS, Motorola, Pixel).
